title: frontend-signoff result.json contract (schema_version 1)
description: Complete contract for asic/<module>/frontend-signoff/result.json. frontend-signoff is an automated aggregator: produces an envelope + checklist/traceability prose artifacts (referenced from artifacts[]). stage_specific has no pass-required fields — substantive content lives in checklist.md and traceability.md (markdown artifact files). On status=fail, stage_specific.fail_reason is required (if/then below) — the one-line failure narrative.
